heading: EXT. MISSOURI RIVER FERRY LANDING - DUSK

units.text: EXT. MISSOURI RIVER FERRY LANDING - DUSK
A flat-bottomed ferry is chained to a cottonwood stump, rocking on brown water the width of a county.
The sky has gone the colour of a bruise.
HOLLIS CRANE, lean and sun-cured, leans on the ferry rail.
He wears a gun he has not touched in nine years.
He watches the far bank without blinking.
A woman stands at the ramp with a carpetbag in each hand.
PERPETUA VANCE, forty, black mourning dress, hat pinned hard.
She sets down one bag.
She keeps the other.
You're the ferryman.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Was.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: He spits over the rail.
The brown water takes it without comment.
Then who is.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Nobody. River's closed since the Tuesday flood. Company let us all go.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: She looks at the chain.
She looks at him.
She says nothing, which is its own kind of answer.
She lifts the second bag and sets it on the plank between them.
The latch is open a finger's width.
Inside, the blued steel of a revolver catches the last light.
Ma'am.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: My husband crossed here a week ago. The man who took his fare. I'd like a word.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: A shout rolls over the water from the far bank, flattened by distance.
Hollis! Is that her? Is that the widow?
units.name: ELIAS TWOCROWS

units.text: He does not turn.
His jaw works.
The hand that rests on the rail begins, very slowly, to slide toward his hip.
Who is that?
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: My brother.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Don't let her on the boat, Hollis!
units.name: ELIAS TWOCROWS

units.text: She steps onto the ferry.
The planks complain.
She puts her hand on the bag.
Then it was you who took the fare.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I took it for him.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: He draws.
She draws.
A crack splits the dusk, then another, and the cottonwood stump fountains bark.
The chain snaps and the ferry lurches free, spinning into the current with the two of them still standing, still firing, on its drifting deck.
